note: Scenarios in this corpus. 'rafael' is the accepted base world, kept in place (root '.'). A scenario with base_world set is a LAYER on that world: it shares the same places, calendar, characters and shared-state timeline, and adds its own threads, events, public facts, state variables and detection streams. IDs in a layer carry its id_prefix so the two never collide and can be released separately or combined.

scenarios.name: Hurricane Rafael
scenarios.summary: Category 3 hurricane on the Texas Coastal Bend with five hidden foreign-state threads (dark tanker, fraud ring, cyber/influence campaign, tanker valve cyberattack, covert military attack on the port).

scenarios.name: Coastal Bend utility cyberattack (Operation DRIFTGLASS)
scenarios.purpose: Educational blue-team / detection hackathon. Teams receive detection telemetry and must separate real storm damage from a deliberate intrusion and correlate it across the electric and water utilities.
scenarios.summary: A foreign-state OT intrusion (same network as Rafael's KESTREL threads) hides inside the hurricane response, deepening and prolonging electric and water outages by manipulating SCADA while the chaos masks it. Modeled at the level of observable effects and detection data only.
